"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"Failure corpus included."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-agent-toolchain"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**The engineering runtime that makes coding agents *verifiably accountable* for their own changes.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A suite of plugins and an MCP server that let a coding agent do more than write code — it can *see* "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"the running desktop application, *drive* it, *measure* it, and *capture* what it sends over the netw"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ork, to check the change it just made. Each plugin is a small, composable building block; together t"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"hey close the loop between "the agent wrote a change" and "the change actually works" — and produce "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"the evidence to prove it."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"One command runs the whole loop against a throwaway WPF window that ships in this repo — build it, l"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"aunch it, drive it, and read the result back out:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Real output (`npm run demo`, paths shortened):"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`npm run demo:perf` additionally reports `stutterCount=1, maxMs=1474` — the sample app blocks its UI"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" thread for exactly 1500 ms on purpose, and the perf probe has to catch it."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> The demo is not demo-only code. `mcp/demo/run-demo.mjs` is an ordinary MCP client: it spawns `mcp/"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"server.mjs` over stdio and calls the same tools Claude Code, Cursor, Cline or Codex would call. If i"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"t passes, the MCP face works."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> Recording a GIF: `npm run demo:perf` while a screen recorder is running is the intended capture — "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"the window does something visible at every step. `docs/media/` is where the recording goes."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Coding agents are excellent at producing patches, but they are blind to what happens after the patch"},{"id":"p13s2","text":": Did the build break? Did the UI actually render the new page? Which API calls did the application "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"fire, and did one of them hang for 20 seconds? Did the change introduce a memory leak or a UI stall?"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Traditional agents verify by reading code. This toolchain lets them verify by *observing the running"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" application* — the same way a human QA engineer would — and then makes them show the evidence."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## The loop"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Path A — the demo path (no Rust, about five minutes)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Exactly the tools `npm run demo` exercises — `build_run`, the `ui_*` family, `perf_probe`, `http_req"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"uest` — need **neither Rust nor MSVC**. Verified on a checkout whose `plugins/*/bin/` directories ar"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"need **neither Rust nor MSVC**. Verified on a checkout whose `plugins/*/bin/` directories are empty."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Node.js 20+ and a .NET SDK (the sample targets `net10.0-windows`).
2. `npm install --prefix mcp` "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"— the MCP server is the only thing with a dependency.
3. `npm run demo`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Nothing is written into the repo tree: a demo run keeps its screenshots, build log and any failure r"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ecords under `.dsh-agent-toolchain/demo/` (gitignored)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Path B — full desktop mode"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"An optional standalone Rust MCP runtime is available through `npm run build:runtime`.
It runs HTTP, "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"background tasks and evidence publication without Node, and can
retain the complete tool catalog thr"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ough a lazy Node compatibility bridge.
See Rust runtime scope, deployment and validation."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The API-capture store, the memory index, flame folding and the terminal inspector load Rust Node-API"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" modules. Build the ones you need (Rust + Visual C++ build tools), or take a deployment that already"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ild the ones you need (Rust + Visual C++ build tools), or take a deployment that already ships them:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Then `pwsh -File install.ps1` (dry run) or `pwsh -File install.ps1 -Apply` to copy the plugins into "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"your DSH profile, register them in `cordis.patch.yml`, and restart the host."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## What this does that a code-reading agent cannot"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Tell the difference between "0 errors" and "the file was compiled".** Legacy `.csproj` projects "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"do not include new `.cs` files automatically, so a build can report success while your file was neve"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"r compiled. `build_compile_check` answers that question specifically, with three states — in the com"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"pilation set, provably not, or *cannot be read* (never silently "not").
- **Operate and observe the "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"real application.** `ui_observe` / `ui_drive` / `ui_flow` find controls by name or AutomationId, cli"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"ck, type, wait for conditions, read values back, and capture window-scoped screenshots. Read-only ac"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"tions never need permission; anything that clicks or types must pass `allowSideEffects=true`, and an"},{"id":"p28s8","text":" optional snapshot-freshness gate rejects actions aimed at a stale UI.
- **Jev-assisted UI decisions"},{"id":"p28s9","text":".** `ui_jev` sends a sanitized UIA control list to Jev, lets it choose one bounded candidate action,"},{"id":"p28s10","text":" then reuses the same deterministic UI executor and safety gates. Jev never receives pixels, generat"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"es arbitrary input, or bypasses authorization; see docs/jev-ui.md.
- **Say "unverified" instead of ""},{"id":"p28s12","text":"passed".** When a tool cannot see something, it reports it as unchecked rather than inventing a gree"},{"id":"p28s13","text":"n result — an empty enumeration is "not read", not "nothing there", and a build reporting 0 errors i"},{"id":"p28s14","text":"s not the same claim as "your file was compiled"."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Tools — 63, of which 25 are read-only"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The single source of truth is `lib/tool-registry.mjs`; both faces (DSH plugins and MCP) are generate"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"d from it, so they cannot drift apart. **Every tool, one line each, sorted by what you are trying to"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" do → docs/tools.md.**"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Plugin | What it does for the agent |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| dsh-build | Run MSBuild / `dotnet build` as a tool: incremental build, structured error list (file"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"/line/col/code), error re-parse, compile-membership check. Build defaults auto-resolve by repo layou"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"t (legacy client layouts keep their defaults byte-for-byte; stock repos get `.sln`/`.slnx` + platfor"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"m auto-detection). |
| dsh-ui-drive | Drive a running Windows desktop client via UIA: find/click/typ"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"e/read/screenshot, visual-tree dumps, multi-step flows with assertions, screenshot + vision descript"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ion. |
| dsh-verify | Toolchain-status and Harness² surface: `toolchain_status` / `toolchain_job` en"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"vironment self-check and job control, plus `harness_trial` / `harness_experience`. (Name kept for id"},{"id":"p32s8","text":" stability; it no longer does verification.) |
